coreRule: A home is assigned to a household, not one home per NPC.
requirements: Every simulated NPC belongs to a household.
Every household has an assigned residential unit.
Residential units belong to physical buildings.
Household members can leave home independently during the day.
Evening/night schedules bias household members toward home.
Night-shift and emergency workers can remain outside.
Simulation must support data-oriented aggregation at distant LODs.
